analysis helper, prospective helper/fixture registration, six retained

negative verdict remain separate and unchanged.

The machine input binding separately supplies 36 existing decision-file
identities, six evaluation-only file identities, implementation-format sources,
the original spool-integrity receipt and both archive hashes. The split is a
data-dependency rule on already exposed development material, not blinding.

Preparation inspected repository sources, metadata and checksums only. It did
not compute the proposed score, open new observation outcomes, stage a run or
change any existing reduction. Exact future helper and fixture identities
must be registered after approval and before scoring; that mechanical step
cannot alter the method or limits approved here. This manifest excludes its
own bytes. The proposal commit binds it together with the status update.
